notes: Source: official Dolby "Dolby® Integrated Media Server IMS3000" product sheet (Imaging – April 2022 edition; Model CID1002), hosted at professional.dolby.com. This is a rack-frame card/module (not a standalone chassis) — no standalone AC/DC power inlet is documented on the unit; it is powered via the host rack frame/backplane, and the sheet only states power consumption (<70 W), so no power port is listed. Model variants matter: IMS3000-NB adds dual 3G-SDI inputs and dual-projector Chase mode; IMS3000-DS omits SDI (single-projector only); IMS3-L-NB targets LED-wall cinema installs. eSATA has no matching connector id in the allowed list and was mapped to usb-a as the closest analog (flagged per-port). GPI/GPO/AES-3/Fader/Atmos-Connect ports are all physically RJ-45 jacks per the rear-panel photo but carry non-Ethernet signaling (contact closures, AES3 audio pairs, or AES67 audio-over-IP), not general Ethernet traffic — grades were only applied to the 3 plain GbE data ports. Rack unit height could not be confirmed from the sourced documentation, so rackUnits is omitted.

ports.name: Eth 0
ports.note: Rear panel silkscreen groups jacks as "ETH-0/1" / "ETH-2/3"; spec states 3 x GB Ethernet 1000Base-T total

ports.name: eSATA
ports.note: Actual port is eSATA 3 Gbps; eSATA is not in the allowed connector list so usb-a (closest data-port analog) was chosen — no grade applied since eSATA does not map onto the USB speed scale

ports.name: SDI-A
ports.note: Dual 3G-SDI inputs are only present on the IMS3000-NB variant (enables dual-projector Chase mode); the IMS3000-DS variant omits SDI entirely

ports.name: SDI-B
ports.note: See SDI-A note re. IMS3000-NB vs -DS variants

ports.name: HDMI-In
ports.note: HDMI 2.0, up to 4K60, HDCP 2.2, Rec.2020-to-P3 conversion, 4K downscale to 2K

ports.name: AES-3 Out (Ch 1-4)
ports.note: Physical RJ-45 jack carrying AES-3 digital audio pairs (not Ethernet data); spec states 8 x AES-3 pairs across 2 x RJ-45 jacks

ports.name: AES-3 Out (Ch 5-8)
ports.note: Second AES-3-over-RJ45 jack, same note as Ch 1-4

ports.name: Aux AES-3 Out
ports.note: 2 x AES-3 auxiliary output pairs; panel labels this area "AUX AES / FADER" — exact connector shape inferred from rear-panel photo

ports.name: Aux AES-3 In
ports.note: 2 x AES-3 auxiliary input pairs, same physical area as Aux AES-3 Out

ports.name: Dolby Atmos Connect Out
ports.note: AES67 audio-over-IP output with loopback monitoring; no Ethernet speed stated so grade omitted

ports.name: GPI (1-4)
ports.note: 4 GPI contact-closure inputs multiplexed on a single RJ-45 jack

ports.name: GPO (1-6)
ports.note: 6 GPO contact-closure outputs multiplexed on a single RJ-45 jack

ports.name: LTC Out
ports.note: Linear timecode output; exact connector shape not spelled out in text spec, inferred as a mini-jack from typical cinema-server practice and rear-panel photo — low-medium confidence

ports.name: Console Out
ports.note: Mini DisplayPort debug console output only (no UI/no video), so no DisplayPort grade is applicable

ports.name: Remote Fader Port
ports.note: For optional CAT868 remote fader control panel
